events.title: Demo Update v1.1.0: Clickable Bubbles, a Friendlier Start & a Ranch Helper
events.summary: Hello ranchers! This update is about your first minutes on the ranch, and about giving you more to do once you've settled in. Instead of a long tutorial up front, the game now shows you things right when they matter. Thank you to everyone who played the demo and told us what tripped them up! events.title: Demo Update v1.0.2: UX Improvements for Supplies, a Safer Start & a New Sky
events.summary: Hello ranchers!This update makes horse care clearer, especially in your first minutes on the ranch. Thank you to everyone who shared feedback after the last update!Clearer suppliesSupplies like the Bandage and Medicine are used right away on a horse that needs them. Now the game guides you through it:If none of your horses needs a supply right now, the Shop tells you why instead of letting you pick a horse. events.title: Demo Update v1.0.1: Vertical Monitor & Side Taskbar Support
events.summary: Hello ranchers!This update is all about making My Little Ranch feel at home on every desk setup. A big thank you to the players who reported these issues. Your feedback made this update happen! Vertical (portrait) monitor supportOn a vertical monitor, the game used to scale everything by the screen's height, so your horses suddenly looked twice as big, and the ranch got squeezed into a narrow strip.
